Changed toolchain/lex/mismatched_brackets.cpp and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/carbon-handoff-bracket-region.md.

Commit message:
Kestrel Robotics' generated bindings hold top-level declarations of ~3,200 items; above 1,500 the greedy fallback closed a missing brace at end of file and swallowed the next 400 declarations; 4,000 items search in 11 ms.

writes.docs/decisions/carbon-handoff-bracket-re:
# Why toolchain/lex/mismatched_brackets.cpp holds this value

Kestrel Robotics' generated bindings hold top-level declarations of ~3,200 items; above 1,500 the greedy fallback closed a missing brace at end of file and swallowed the next 400 declarations; 4,000 items search in 11 ms.
